    $(document).ready(function() {
        var scrollH = document.getElementById('scrollH');
        if (scrollH) {
            $('#scrollH').scroll(function() {
                var $width = $('#scrollH').outerWidth();
                var $scrollWidth = scrollH.scrollWidth;
                var $scrollLeft = $('#scrollH').scrollLeft();

                // Check if scrolled all the way to the right (with small tolerance for rounding)
                if ($scrollLeft >= $scrollWidth - $width - 1) {
                    $('.scroll-arrow.right').fadeOut();
                    $('.scroll-arrow.left').fadeIn();
                } else if ($scrollLeft === 0) {
                    $('.scroll-arrow.right').fadeIn();
                    $('.scroll-arrow.left').fadeOut();
                } else {
                    $('.scroll-arrow.right').fadeIn();
                    $('.scroll-arrow.left').fadeIn();
                }
            });

            var hasHorizontalScrollbar = scrollH.scrollWidth > scrollH.clientWidth;
            if (hasHorizontalScrollbar) {
                $('.scroll-arrow.right').show();
            }
            $('.scroll-arrow.right').click(function() {
                $('#scrollH').animate({
                    scrollLeft: '+=275'
                }, 1000, 'easeOutQuad');
            });
            $('.scroll-arrow.left').click(function() {
                $('#scrollH').animate({
                    scrollLeft: '-=275'
                }, 1000, 'easeOutQuad');
            });
        }

        var slider = document.querySelector('.related-items-list');
        if (slider) {
            var isDown = false;
            var startX;
            var scrollLeftVal;

            slider.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
                isDown = true;
                slider.classList.add('active');
                startX = e.pageX - slider.offsetLeft;
                scrollLeftVal = slider.scrollLeft;
            });
            slider.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
                isDown = false;
                slider.classList.remove('active');
            });
            slider.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
                isDown = false;
                slider.classList.remove('active');
                $('#load-more').hide();
            });
            slider.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
                if (!isDown) return;
                e.preventDefault();
                var x = e.pageX - slider.offsetLeft;
                var walk = (x - startX) * 3; //scroll-fast
                slider.scrollLeft = scrollLeftVal - walk;
            });
        }
    });

    $(window).resize(function() {
        var div = document.getElementById('scrollH');
        if (div) {
            var hasHorizontalScrollbar = div.scrollWidth > div.clientWidth;
            if (hasHorizontalScrollbar) {
                $('.scroll-arrow.right').show();
            } else {
                $('.scroll-arrow').fadeOut();
            }
        }
    });
</script>

    $(document).ready(function() {
        var scrollH = document.getElementById('scrollH');
        if (scrollH) {
            $('#scrollH').scroll(function() {
                var $width = $('#scrollH').outerWidth();
                var $scrollWidth = scrollH.scrollWidth;
                var $scrollLeft = $('#scrollH').scrollLeft();

                // Check if scrolled all the way to the right (with small tolerance for rounding)
                if ($scrollLeft >= $scrollWidth - $width - 1) {
                    $('.scroll-arrow.right').fadeOut();
                    $('.scroll-arrow.left').fadeIn();
                } else if ($scrollLeft === 0) {
                    $('.scroll-arrow.right').fadeIn();
                    $('.scroll-arrow.left').fadeOut();
                } else {
                    $('.scroll-arrow.right').fadeIn();
                    $('.scroll-arrow.left').fadeIn();
                }
            });

            var hasHorizontalScrollbar = scrollH.scrollWidth > scrollH.clientWidth;
            if (hasHorizontalScrollbar) {
                $('.scroll-arrow.right').show();
            }
            $('.scroll-arrow.right').click(function() {
                $('#scrollH').animate({
                    scrollLeft: '+=275'
                }, 1000, 'easeOutQuad');
            });
            $('.scroll-arrow.left').click(function() {
                $('#scrollH').animate({
                    scrollLeft: '-=275'
                }, 1000, 'easeOutQuad');
            });
        }

        var slider = document.querySelector('.related-items-list');
        if (slider) {
            var isDown = false;
            var startX;
            var scrollLeftVal;

            slider.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
                isDown = true;
                slider.classList.add('active');
                startX = e.pageX - slider.offsetLeft;
                scrollLeftVal = slider.scrollLeft;
            });
            slider.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
                isDown = false;
                slider.classList.remove('active');
            });
            slider.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
                isDown = false;
                slider.classList.remove('active');
                $('#load-more').hide();
            });
            slider.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
                if (!isDown) return;
                e.preventDefault();
                var x = e.pageX - slider.offsetLeft;
                var walk = (x - startX) * 3; //scroll-fast
                slider.scrollLeft = scrollLeftVal - walk;
            });
        }
    });

    $(window).resize(function() {
        var div = document.getElementById('scrollH');
        if (div) {
            var hasHorizontalScrollbar = div.scrollWidth > div.clientWidth;
            if (hasHorizontalScrollbar) {
                $('.scroll-arrow.right').show();
            } else {
                $('.scroll-arrow').fadeOut();
            }
        }
    });
</script>

    $(document).ready(function() {
        var scrollH = document.getElementById('scrollH');
        if (scrollH) {
            $('#scrollH').scroll(function() {
                var $width = $('#scrollH').outerWidth();
                var $scrollWidth = scrollH.scrollWidth;
                var $scrollLeft = $('#scrollH').scrollLeft();

                // Check if scrolled all the way to the right (with small tolerance for rounding)
                if ($scrollLeft >= $scrollWidth - $width - 1) {
                    $('.scroll-arrow.right').fadeOut();
                    $('.scroll-arrow.left').fadeIn();
                } else if ($scrollLeft === 0) {
                    $('.scroll-arrow.right').fadeIn();
                    $('.scroll-arrow.left').fadeOut();
                } else {
                    $('.scroll-arrow.right').fadeIn();
                    $('.scroll-arrow.left').fadeIn();
                }
            });

            var hasHorizontalScrollbar = scrollH.scrollWidth > scrollH.clientWidth;
            if (hasHorizontalScrollbar) {
                $('.scroll-arrow.right').show();
            }
            $('.scroll-arrow.right').click(function() {
                $('#scrollH').animate({
                    scrollLeft: '+=275'
                }, 1000, 'easeOutQuad');
            });
            $('.scroll-arrow.left').click(function() {
                $('#scrollH').animate({
                    scrollLeft: '-=275'
                }, 1000, 'easeOutQuad');
            });
        }

        var slider = document.querySelector('.related-items-list');
        if (slider) {
            var isDown = false;
            var startX;
            var scrollLeftVal;

            slider.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
                isDown = true;
                slider.classList.add('active');
                startX = e.pageX - slider.offsetLeft;
                scrollLeftVal = slider.scrollLeft;
            });
            slider.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
                isDown = false;
                slider.classList.remove('active');
            });
            slider.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
                isDown = false;
                slider.classList.remove('active');
                $('#load-more').hide();
            });
            slider.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
                if (!isDown) return;
                e.preventDefault();
                var x = e.pageX - slider.offsetLeft;
                var walk = (x - startX) * 3; //scroll-fast
                slider.scrollLeft = scrollLeftVal - walk;
            });
        }
    });

    $(window).resize(function() {
        var div = document.getElementById('scrollH');
        if (div) {
            var hasHorizontalScrollbar = div.scrollWidth > div.clientWidth;
            if (hasHorizontalScrollbar) {
                $('.scroll-arrow.right').show();
            } else {
                $('.scroll-arrow').fadeOut();
            }
        }
    });
</script>
